run_static_react_task_with_authorization: run a mephisto static react task with authorization using the local inhouse operator
build_static_react_task: build a static react task app with optional force rebuild and post install script
create_shared_static_task_state: create a SharedStaticTaskState with static task data items and qualification requirements
make_qualification_dict: create a qualification dictionary with a name, comparison operator, and threshold value
launch_task_run_and_wait: launch a mephisto task run with config and shared state then wait for completion
